newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close off as results disappoint.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close off as results disappoint.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed lower in sluggish trade after a slew of company results left the market disappointed, traders said.

The bolsa's leading 19-share index slipped 0.43 percent to end at 6,389.51 points as nearly 39 million shares traded, worth eight billion bolivars ($16.8 million), according to preliminary figures from the exchange.
One trader said that the market was already depressed by on-going labor problems, and "today's company results by market leaders such as Electricidad de Caracas were quite weak."
Electricidad, which closed off 1.00 bolivar at 485.00, reported a 62.7 billion bolivar year net profit versus last year's 64.3 bln bolivar net profit.

Among traded issues, 21 fell, eight rose and 11 closed flat. Leading steel company Sivensa, which closed off 3.00 bolivars at 325.00, meanwhile reported late Friday a 63 percent rise in first quarter profits to 1.8 billion bolivars.

"People must be investing in real estate because they're not in stocks or dollars, and they're certainly not in banks what with negative real savings rates," said one trader. ((-- Ana Isabel Martinez, Caracas newsroom, 582 505 2600))
